questions.stem: The average age of \(25\) students in a class is \(18\) years. When a new student joins the class, the average age becomes \(18.5\) years. What is the age of the new student?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages of \(25\) students = \(25 \times 18 = 450\) years
After new student joins, total students = \(26\)
New sum = \(26 \times 18.5 = 481\) years
Age of new student = \(481 - 450 = 31\) years

questions.stem: In a class of \(30\) students, the average marks in mathematics is \(75\). If \(5\) new students join with an average of \(85\) marks, what is the new average of the class?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of marks of \(30\) students = \(30 \times 75 = 2250\)
Sum of marks of \(5\) new students = \(5 \times 85 = 425\)
Total sum = \(2250 + 425 = 2675\)
Total students = \(30 + 5 = 35\)
New average = \(\frac{2675}{35} = 76.43\)

questions.stem: The average weight of \(40\) students in a class is \(55\) kg. When \(8\) students leave the class, the average weight becomes \(52\) kg. What was the average weight of the students who left?
questions.keySolution:
Total weight of \(40\) students = \(40 \times 55 = 2200\) kg
Weight of remaining \(32\) students = \(32 \times 52 = 1664\) kg
Weight of \(8\) students who left = \(2200 - 1664 = 536\) kg
Average weight of students who left = \(\frac{536}{8} = 67\) kg

questions.stem: In a group of \(20\) people, the average age is \(24\) years. If \(4\) people with ages \(28, 30, 26, 32\) join the group, what will be the new average age?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of ages of \(20\) people = \(20 \times 24 = 480\) years
Sum of ages of \(4\) new people = \(28 + 30 + 26 + 32 = 116\) years
Total sum = \(480 + 116 = 596\) years
Total people = \(20 + 4 = 24\)
New average = \(\frac{596}{24} = 24.83\) years

questions.stem: The average salary of \(15\) employees in a company is ₹\(45,000\). When a manager joins, the average becomes ₹\(48,000\). What is the manager's salary?
questions.keySolution:
Sum of salaries of \(15\) employees = \(15 \times 45,000 = ₹6,75,000\)
After manager joins, total employees = \(16\)
New sum = \(16 \times 48,000 = ₹7,68,000\)
Manager's salary = \(7,68,000 - 6,75,000 = ₹93,000\)

questions.stem: In a cricket team of \(11\) players, the average age is \(26\) years. If the captain who is \(32\) years old is replaced by a new player, the average age becomes \(25\) years. What is the age of the new player?

Sum of ages of \(11\) players = \(11 \times 26 = 286\) years
After replacement, sum = \(11 \times 25 = 275\) years
Decrease in sum = \(286 - 275 = 11\) years
Age of new player = \(32 - 11 = 21\) years

questions.stem: In a class of \(28\) students, the average marks in English is \(72\). If \(8\) students with an average of \(65\) marks leave and \(4\) students with an average of \(88\) marks join, what is the new average?

questions.stem: The average height of \(10\) basketball players is \(185\) cm. When \(2\) players with heights \(180\) cm and \(175\) cm are replaced by \(2\) new players, the average becomes \(187\) cm. What is the average height of the new players?

Average height of new players = \(\frac{375}{2} = 187.5\) cm
